goal: Implement contextual UI feedback and labelled navigation with no permanent footer.

decision_rules.condition: Idle or read transitions occur while save/error state exists
decision_rules.outcome: Read pending/success/failure is local to Refresh/pull; successful refresh never clears save errors, operation notices or Undo. Refresh failure remains actionable until retry succeeds. No save icon is projected as refresh status.
decision_rules.rationale: Separate authoritative application state from rendering effects and preserve delegated UX.

decision_rules.condition: Unknown save, draft validation/conflict, operation failure or retained offscreen input exists
decision_rules.outcome: Derive labelled recovery items with target/context and explicit callbacks. Visible target uses inline controls; hidden target is reachable from a persistent toolbar recovery entry opening a focused in-flow recovery surface. Items clear only on authoritative resolution or explicit draft discard when existing controller permits it; never by unrelated read/success/dismiss.
decision_rules.rationale: Separate authoritative application state from rendering effects and preserve delegated UX.

decision_rules.condition: Acknowledged write gives lastOperation or explicit Undo/dismiss event occurs
decision_rules.outcome: Store notice identity and undoOf, dismiss only matching notice identity. Capture undoOf before dispatch; disable pending Undo, retain notice on failure and show conflict without automatic retry against fresh revision. If newer write replaces notice while old Undo settles, old completion cannot dismiss newer notice. Dismiss clears only presentation, not lastOperation/history; Changes retains server-retained history.
decision_rules.rationale: Separate authoritative application state from rendering effects and preserve delegated UX.

domain_details.implementation: Use a small model projection and one reusable contextual feedback component with readonly props/callbacks. Names/file splits are private within existing layer rules; avoid a notification framework. Preserve all current callers of message by migrating them to typed application notices or dedicated read state, not an untyped catch-all footer.

requirements.statement: The UI shall show visible names beside standard sidebar icons at every width and reserve no idle footer space.
When refresh, save or an operation changes state, the UI shall project their typed states independently at the responsible control or pane.
While input, unknown writes or failures remain unresolved, the UI shall keep actionable recovery reachable across navigation without losing drafts or exact requests.
When a write provides Undo, the UI shall retain an untimed dismissible Undo affordance and preserve Changes history and conflict protection.
Feedback changes shall preserve input focus, caret, IME, active gestures and bounded independent scroll areas.

in_scope: Shared UI model/controller/component/DOM feedback and sidebar layout; owning contextual-feedback change package; tests and architecture documentation.
out_of_scope: Backend, API, persistence, auth, native iOS acceptance, new notification platform.
